notes: Spike finding: Betsson redirects to regional domain (e.g. betsson.es) when accessed from specific IPs (Spain); runner proxy or local execution needed if geoblocked (R3).
Authentication uses custom Web Components (fdsp-button) for login trigger and submission.
Login inputs are identified by name='email' (id='email-input') and name='password' (id='password-input').
OneTrust cookie banner must be accepted prior to interacting with header buttons.
Pragmatic Play games are rendered inside cross-origin iframes with no DOM access permitted (R9).
Game cards in casino lobby are structured as 'a.preview-item' containing game title and 'Pragmatic Play' provider label.
Balance display in Betsson header is accessible via DOM for verification (S1.01, S1.10, S2.07).
